menstruation.bio: Intense fatigue, hormone crash, potential pain (cramps, back). She needs to retreat and recharge.
menstruation.action: Take over. Don't ask "can I help?" — just do it. Handle meals, groceries, or the kids.
menstruation.attitude: Bring comfort: hot water bottle, tea, blanket. Suggest quiet evenings at home rather than going out.
menstruation.avoid: Blaming her for being tired or unmotivated.

follicular.bio: Estrogen rises. Energy returns, mood lifts, she wants to start projects and get moving.
follicular.action: Encourage her! Suggest outings, sports, or plan the next vacation together.
follicular.attitude: Enjoy her renewed lightness — laugh together, go out, have fun.
follicular.avoid: This is the best time for rational discussions or sorting out logistics.

ovulation.bio: Hormonal peak. She's often radiant, confident, outgoing. Her libido is at its biological maximum.
ovulation.action: Connect. Plan a date night, prioritize intimacy.
ovulation.attitude: Compliment her, be flirty. She's chemically more open to communication and connection.
ovulation.avoid: Ignoring her cues to spend time together.

luteal.bio: Progesterone rises then crashes (PMS). Irritability, sadness, self-criticism. This is the turbulence zone.
luteal.action: Don't take anything personally. If she snaps over a small thing, her tolerance threshold has simply dropped.
luteal.attitude: Listen and be patient. She wants empathy, not a technical fix. Don't judge her cravings — it's physiological.
luteal.avoid: Saying "Are you about to get your period?" — even if true, it's the worst possible thing to say.
